anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Buffer differential pressure was 1.983 mbar, within the preceding range of 1.755–2.294 mbar.
Buffer differential pressure rose to 3.356 mbar while distillate and reflux flows fell to 0.082 and 0.084.
Buffer differential pressure partially recovered to 2.515 mbar but remains above its earlier range; flows recovered to 0.125 and 0.164.
Column differential pressure, system pressure, cooling flow and level switches remain within previously observed behavior; no clear system-wide pressure excursion.

args.missing_evidence: Confirm whether a commanded operating change explains the transient; verify buffer pressure independently and inspect the buffer outlet/vent path if elevation persists. Temperature instruments are not installed. No composition measurement or target criterion is available to assess separation.
